'''Orpharya''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When she forbade Praetor [[Nollus]] from pursuing and destroying the last groups of Tarisian [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by Mad [[Raggo Tolin]], he hired an Imperial to do the job for him instead.
